workflow.artifact: product class declaration with selected bands and priors
workflow.gate: the assigned class's full band set is coherent with the formula or the product is declared out of scope

workflow.action: Sum hidden plus added water and audit hydration
workflow.description: Convert eggs, dairy, butter, and purees to water grams and compare the total to the class band
workflow.artifact: hydration ledger with band position and headroom
workflow.gate: the hidden-water sum recomputes independently within 2 points and the band verdict names its headroom

workflow.action: Audit fat, sugar, and salt bands
workflow.description: Check carrier-vs-pure-fat, sugar band with the high-ratio precondition, and salt at 1.8-2.2% including hidden salted-butter salt
workflow.gate: every out-of-band line carries its gram correction and the high-ratio precondition is verified where sugar exceeds 110%

workflow.action: Split the leavening budget by acidity
workflow.description: Inventory acids, allocate soda (2.3 g per 245 g buttermilk-class acid), convert at 3-3.5x, top up with powder to 3-4%
workflow.gate: every soda gram traces to a named acid and total powder-equivalent lands in band

workflow.action: Compute pan volume, depth, and fill
workflow.description: Use true pan area (water-fill calibrated if nonstandard), the class density prior, and depth = m/(rho x A)
workflow.artifact: pan plan with depth and fill fraction per pan
workflow.gate: fill sits inside the class window (neither over ceiling nor under floor) using the current best density value

workflow.action: Set the time estimate and the doneness gate
workflow.description: Scale a known reference bake by (depth ratio)^0.8-1.1 and attach the class internal-temperature target
workflow.artifact: time window with first-probe schedule and center-temp target
workflow.gate: the estimate carries exponent bounds and the temperature target is declared as the release authority

workflow.action: Plan raw batch size from target yield
workflow.description: Invert bake loss and residue: raw = target/((1-bake loss)x(1-residue)) and forward-check the mass chain
workflow.artifact: yield plan with the panned/baked/portioned mass chain
workflow.gate: forward and inverse yield computations agree within 1%

workflow.action: Apply swaps and constraints, then close and re-audit
workflow.description: Run the closure ledger for each substitution (water, fat, sugar, salt, acid lines), apply dietary ceilings, then re-run the audit pass
workflow.artifact: closure ledger plus refreshed audit with headroom report
workflow.gate: every band a swap touched re-audits in range and the SG cup test confirms the density assumption before panning

dominance_rules.rule: Internal temperature dominates any computed bake time
dominance_rules.rationale: the depth exponent is a scheduling model with 0.3 of exponent uncertainty, while center temperature is the physical doneness fact
dominance_rules.trigger: the timer window and the thermometer disagree at the pull decision
dominance_rules.action: hold or release on the class temperature window; use the time model only to schedule the first probe

dominance_rules.rule: A measured specific gravity dominates the class density prior
dominance_rules.rationale: density encodes that day's technique and hold time, which no prior can see
dominance_rules.trigger: the cup test returns a value differing from the assumed prior
dominance_rules.action: recompute depth, fill, and tier allocation with the measured SG and log it toward a house prior

dominance_rules.rule: Gram mass dominates volume measures wherever both exist
dominance_rules.rationale: volume constants vary up to 2.1x by technique and crystal while a scale does not
dominance_rules.trigger: a formula line is available in both cups/spoons and grams, or conversion assumptions conflict
dominance_rules.action: compute all budgets from grams and demote the volume line to a label

dominance_rules.rule: The fill-fraction ceiling dominates batch integrity
dominance_rules.rationale: overflow ruins the bake, the pan, and the oven at once, while diverted batter is merely a second format
dominance_rules.trigger: computed fill exceeds the class ceiling in the chosen pan
dominance_rules.action: cap the pan at its ceiling and divert surplus to another vessel with its own depth-scaled time

dominance_rules.rule: Acid neutralization dominates lift top-up in the leavening split
dominance_rules.rationale: unneutralized soda leaves soapy alkaline defects that no amount of correct total lift redeems
dominance_rules.trigger: a formula contains both soda and an acid inventory, or an acidic swap lands
dominance_rules.action: allocate soda to named acids first, convert at 3-3.5x, and only then top up with powder to the 3-4% band

dominance_rules.rule: The tightened eggless ceiling dominates the general class hydration band
dominance_rules.rationale: without egg protein the crumb cannot hold band-maximum water, so the general band is unsafe by construction
dominance_rules.trigger: an eggless constraint is active on a formula near the top of its hydration band
dominance_rules.action: enforce band-minus-5-to-10-points as the operative ceiling for all wet decisions

dominance_rules.rule: Flour-basis recomputation dominates every downstream percentage
dominance_rules.rationale: a changed denominator silently invalidates all bands at once, which no individual band check will catch
dominance_rules.trigger: cocoa, a new flour, or a preferment enters or leaves the formula
dominance_rules.action: re-fix the basis first and re-run the full audit before trusting any percentage

dominance_rules.rationale: a swap without a closed ledger is an unaudited new formula wearing the old recipe's name
dominance_rules.trigger: any ingredient substitution, however small it seems
dominance_rules.action: run the closure ledger for the touched budgets and re-audit before the formula is baked or shared

dominance_rules.rule: Diagnosis dominates auto-correction on out-of-band heirlooms
dominance_rules.rationale: bands are priors, and a repeatedly successful recipe is stronger evidence than the prior it violates
dominance_rules.trigger: a proven recipe fails a band check
dominance_rules.action: report the deviation, predicted consequence, and gram correction, but change nothing without the user's decision

anti_rework_rules.rule: Convert all volumes to grams with recorded assumptions before any percentage math
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-deriving the entire formula when a cup-technique or salt-crystal ambiguity surfaces mid-audit

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the flour basis before computing a single percentage
anti_rework_rules.prevents: recomputing every band verdict after cocoa or preferment flour is discovered in the denominator

anti_rework_rules.rule: Book hidden water at intake, not when the hydration verdict looks wrong
anti_rework_rules.prevents: chasing a phantom 30-60 point hydration error backward through a finished audit

anti_rework_rules.rule: Water-fill calibrate any nonstandard pan before its first use
anti_rework_rules.prevents: replanning fills and rescuing overflowed bakes every time the flared pan reappears

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the SG cup test before panning, never after
anti_rework_rules.prevents: repanning or diverting batter once the real density has already contradicted the fill plan

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set the internal-temperature target when the timer is set, not when doubt strikes
anti_rework_rules.prevents: mid-bake scrambling and repeated oven-door openings that themselves stretch the bake

anti_rework_rules.rule: Close every touched budget in the same session as the swap
anti_rework_rules.prevents: stacked half-closed swaps compounding into a formula whose drift must be untangled line by line

anti_rework_rules.rule: Size the raw batch from target/(1-loss) before mixing
anti_rework_rules.prevents: remixing a supplementary partial batch (with its own residue loss) to cover a predictable 12% shortfall

iteration_protocol.trigger: a bake exits gummy, sunken, or wet-crumbed despite an in-band audit
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify hidden-water bookings and the flour basis, then test whether a class band edge or a produce constant is mis-set

iteration_protocol.trigger: a pan overflows or a layer bakes conspicuously shallow at computed fill
iteration_protocol.action: re-measure SG, water-fill the pan, and recompute depth and fill with measured values replacing priors

iteration_protocol.trigger: actual bake time misses the predicted window by more than 20%
iteration_protocol.action: refit the house depth exponent within 0.8-1.1 from the logged depth/time pairs for that oven and product class

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new habitual ingredient or swap enters the kitchen (new sweetener, dairy, fat, or acid)
iteration_protocol.action: add its water fraction and acid coefficient to the constants tables and re-run closure on affected house formulas

iteration_protocol.trigger: a bake tastes flat, salty, soapy, or metallic at in-band doses
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the volume-to-mass conversions (crystal constants) and the soda-to-acid allocation before touching the bands

iteration_protocol.trigger: a pan, tier set, or format changes for a recurring recipe
iteration_protocol.action: recompute area ratios, fill, depth, and the time window; update the recipe's recorded pan plan

iteration_protocol.trigger: finished yield repeatedly under-runs the plan by more than 3%
iteration_protocol.action: weigh the mass chain (mixed/panned/baked) on the next bake and revise the bake-loss or residue constant that breaks

priority_rationale: The percentage convention, flour basis, gram conversion, and product classification come first because every band, prior, and formula downstream is stated in their units; the hydration/fat/sugar/salt/leavening budgets and the density-geometry chain build on them in parallel; and swap closure, dietary ceilings, tiering, yield, and the audit come last because they re-combine every earlier constant into decisions that are expensive to unwind after mixing.
